claim: Rodriguez et al. tabulate the same percentage (relative tactic occurrence) over the events of an attack log, in which one tactic can log many events (Table 3)
quote: Table3summarizestheinformationcontainedinthelabeled event log. Almost 79.88% of the activity is concentrated in 3 types of events:execution, defense_evasion, persistence.
locator: Sec. 4.4.1 and Table 3 'Log Summary (ProM)', PDF p. 8; pinpoint 'Table 3' correct
issue: Table 3's 'Occur. (rel.)' column is the share of 7265 labelled events per tactic class (e.g. 'execution 3270 45.01%'), pooled over 21 red-team cases. Two of its 14 classes are artificial 'Start' and 'End' events (0.29 % each), so Rodriguez's denominator is not tactics only; immaterial to 'the same percentage'.
